{{Quote|Right now it's two weapons against one, Ben. Let's make it one against one. Dantooinian firing squad.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
A '''Dantooinian firing squad''' referred to a ring of [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] armed with projectile weapons, targeting another being within the ring's center with the intent to [[Death/Legends|kill]]. As a result, participants in the firing squad often eliminated one another in addition to the intended target. In [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]], a [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooinian]] firing [[Squad/Legends|squad]] involved a target flanked on both sides, whose evasive maneuvering resulted in one of the oppressors eliminating the other. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] attempted to perform a Dantooinian firing squad maneuver while under attack on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] by the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], which was under the control of [[Abeloth]].
